title: Exchange fluid pressure and contact forces
scope: Implement balanced cross-system pressure/contact operators using the agreed equal-material profile.
acceptance: No external force: pair exchange conserves momentum within the specified tolerance.
Split versus combined populations pass pressure/contact fixtures.
evidence: CPU Slang split-versus-combined fixture matches acceleration, one-step position, velocity and foam, including a coincident cross-system pair.
The fixture applies the specified particle-mass impulse calculation and passes the 5e-5 balanced-momentum residual limit with nonzero exchange.
All 49 foundation tests pass or report their existing capability skips; Slang CPU, CUDA and Vulkan driver targets build.
